criteria.name: token_limit_accuracy
criteria.description: Actual token limits are correct or close to real API values (within +/- 20%); identifies that Claude models support 8192 output tokens, gpt-4o supports 16384, Gemini supports much more

criteria.name: dangerous_flags
criteria.description: Correctly identifies models where 16384 exceeds the actual limit (e.g., Claude Haiku 3.5 / phi-3-mini) and explains API error consequences

criteria.name: priority_ranking
criteria.description: Critical items are models where current config exceeds actual limit; important items are those significantly under-configured; priorities are logical

criteria.name: config_snippet
criteria.description: Provides 3 corrected JSON config blocks with correct values and clear reason strings
